workflows.name: Plan a trip: pick a flight, a hotel and an activity, then note the plan
steps: In the Google Flights tab (if a Google consent page shows, click "Reject all"), set Where from to Paris and Where to to {destination}
Set the dates to {depart} and {return}, click Done, then click Search
Read the airline and price of the first (best) flight. Do not click Select or Book
Switch to the Booking.com tab, type {destination} in the destination box, set the dates {depart} to {return}, click Search
Open the first hotel with a review score of 8 or more and note its name and total price. Do not click Reserve
Switch to the Viator tab, search "{activity} {destination}", open the first result and note its name and price. Do not click Check availability, Reserve or Book
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Trip {destination} {depart}-{return}: flight <airline> <price>, hotel <name> <price>, {activity} <name> <price>" and press Enter

workflows.name: Compare two Python libraries on PyPI and GitHub
steps: In the PyPI tab, click the search box, type {package_a}, press Enter and open the exact {package_a} result. Note the latest version and its release date
In the left sidebar click its Source / Repository / Homepage link to GitHub and read the star count and license
Go back to PyPI, search {package_b}, open the exact result and note the latest version and release date
Click its Source / Repository link to GitHub and read the star count and license
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{package_a} <version> <date> <stars> stars <license> vs {package_b} <version> <date> <stars> stars <license>" and press Enter

workflows.name: Answer a browser-support ticket with caniuse and MDN
steps: In the caniuse tab, click the search box and type "{feature}"
In the support table, find {browser} and note the first version that supports it (or that it is unsupported)
Open a new tab, go to developer.mozilla.org, search "{feature}" with the site's search and open the reference page; note its URL
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {customer}@example.com, then click Subject and type "Re: {feature} in {browser}"
Click Body and type "Hi {customer}, {feature} is supported in {browser} from version <version> (or: not supported yet). Docs: <MDN URL>"
Do not click Send. Click Discard to clear the draft, then close the MDN tab

TRIP.3.note: In step 4, first type "Barcleona", notice the typo, fix it to "Barcelona", then continue
